comment: I found it impossible to pay attention in his class. Granted, I have no interest in accounting. However, his lectures were very dry with him writing a lot on the board and explaining very little. I think I learned more from the textbook then from the time in class. Also, his tests are long and pretty challenging. I've heard he's good if you want to be an accounting major but if you're just taking the class for the business requirement, I wouldn't recommend him

His class isn't really all that hard, but it's a lot of self-teaching. He's super nice, but gets distracted easily and gets off on tangents about unrelated topics. That being said, he's kind of the man.
Loved Fagan, great guy and really knows what he is talking about.
FAGAN IS THE MAN

Prof Fagan is AMAZING!!!  He is one of the best professors on campus and the reason why I am an accounting major! His teaching methods are awesome, great for helping outside of class. I hope for him to teach upper level classes so that I can have him again!

Eh, he is ok.  Class is not super hard, but it is not a joke. You need to read the book and pay attention and a B is simple.  To get an A, it takes quite a bit of work.  Good guy, fun guy, super southern, but not the best class

Read the textbook. He doesn't really write notes. Took basically the whole class period going over homework and not much else. He's not really helpful. Definitely have to teach yourself. It wasn't hard for me since I had taken an accounting class before, but it was still frustrating for me. He's very nit picky on the tests and quizzes.
Took his Excel class, didn't really seem to learn much. Not a very engaging guy. Really strict attendance policy, if you take him make sure you attend every class.
Fagan is amazing. His class is easy if you study hard and do the homework problems. After having him for 201 I took him for 202 as well. One of my favorite professors at Richmond.

Great guy, tells great stories in class. gets sidetracked too easily and doesnt cover much material. tests and quizzes are challenging. his final project was a mess, kept changing directions and took way too long to do. also not available much outside of class.

Fagan is a great guy but a terrible teacher. He doesn't teach the material & spends most of his time telling stupid stories & going on irrelevant tangents.After spending 3 weeks putzing around he'll give a test that is extremely hard & unclear. He teaches only about 25% of what is on the test. DON'T TAKE FAGAN UNLESS YOU HAVE TO (SOFT TOOLS)

Fagan is a disaster. Tested on material never covered, ridiculously hard project, more work than any half unit class should ever have. He is one of the only software tools professors, so taking him in some what unavoidable, but he is by far the WORST professor I have had at the university. However, he doesn't grade most of the work an just gives As
Overall bad.

Fagan is a very strict teacher who teaches a very dry course. He is insensitive to student needs and takes his course and himself very seriously. He is a decent teacher at best. You must learn a lot outside of class. Whereas Hoyle cares about his students, Fagan cares about himself.

Fagan is a guy that you love or you hate.  I personally didn't care for him.  Luckily, the class is very easy (teaches from the book, and final exam is optional).  The man seems very disorganized, gets distracted easily, but you will learn a lot about accounting from the book/when hes not distracted.  Wouldn't personally suggest taking him.

By far the best teacher at Richmond..I had him for both managerial and financial accounting and I took him the second time on purpose at 8:15...He does keep you on your toes but if your willing to participate in class he automatically loves you..Very clear and his stories are hilarious...He is the reason why I am an accounting major!

Not a bad professor. His multiple choice questions are hard but he curves the tests. Do your work and contribute in class and he will like you and help you out. If you have an A or A- before the final he will exempt you from the final.

this guy needs to go crawl under a rock. the university of richmond should be ashamed to have this sorry excuse for a "teacher" around. waste of tuition. jumps all over, mumbles, inconsistent grader, gives irrelevant info, THE LIST GOES ON TOO LONG FOR THIS COMMENT BOX!!

A very good teacher.  He keeps you on your toes the entire class period, make sure you know your stuff or he will make you look like a fool in front of the class.  However, if you do well, participate and put in the time to understand it he will like you.  First test has a big curve, second does not but it easier.  Final is not too hard.

Useful information, VERY boring class. The first 2-3 weeks are spent on a VERY hard research project which he grades harshly. Although he cancelled homework some weeks, he never covered all the material in class. Look forward to long hours of homework and figuring it out yourself.

First 2 weeks are on research databases, very boring and he harshly grades the research assignment from it. Some weeks homework took 1-3 hours, other weeks he canceled it. He could have covered more material (that most internships require you to use) by not delaying our assignments. Overall, the class is useful but not enjoyable.

Fagan gives pop quizzes every other class or so and if you don't show up you automatically get a 0 so don't take him if you don't want to come to class. His tests aren't impossible but the questions are harder than the hw. Somedays he'll give no hw and other days he'll give a ridiculous amount. His lectures are dull-i fell asleep every class.

He's a great teacher. Make sure you do the reading and problems that are assigned. Gives you pop quizzes but it shouldn't be too difficult if you have paid attention the class before. Randomly picks on five people per class period, so make sure you do your work. He is very helpful if you need it.

****an's a good ole' country  boy, but a decent professor at best. He's had a lot of work experience in accounting so he knows the subject quite well, but he has a tendency to present the material in a way that makes it seem very easy, only to give you an unreasonably difficult test. Expect class test averages around of 65-75. Only uses textbook.
really good teacher but don't expect an easy A.  you have to work for it but he is so helpful and a really nice guy.

A dry class with some helpful hints. However, it is not as easy as it seems because he is very erratic in his grading. Sometimes he ignores mistakes and other times you will be sunk by them. Nice guy/OK class.

hasn't got a clue how to teach. he mumbles and speaks low so you can't understand him..he doesn't give you good sample problems to prepare for the tests, so of course you're unprepared for it...he also jumps all over and sometimes i didn't even know if what he was talking about had anything to do with accounting or not which made note-taking hard

Not a very stimulating teacher, however, he explains things very clearly when he is asked.  He is a fairly easy grader, considering he is willing to curve.  He gives a pop quiz pretty much bi-weekly, on which you can score no lower than a 50%.  Tests and quizzes are mostly multiple choice, but you will need to know specifics to do well.

A lot of work for 1 credit.  There's a 10 page essay in the third week that he doesn't read. He uses it as referencing practice. Very practical and hands on.  Not a "fun" class but good if you'll ever use excel. You realize that you have learned something when you take the final.

generally a pretty nice guy, a bit anti-social, very serious, but if you pay attention in class and work a few hours outside of class you shouldn't have any problems.  first test is much harder than expected.  Got an course grade of A-.

He may be a good teacher for intermediate accounting - but definitely not for Tax. This is his first year teaching the course and it's really obvious. He's a nice guy, but he jumps all over the place, he goes on all sorts of tangents, never makes anything clear and that's not a good thing in Tax.
Great person and fun teacher. I would recommend taking him.
awesome, an easy A, make sure u do the HW. weird sense of humor. awesome guy.
No Comments
Best professor on campus.  Witty sense of humor and willing to help outside of class.

Granted I do not enjoy accounting, but Dr.****an is not a stimulating professor, and is unreasonable in the content and length of his tests.  He is a fair grader, and helpful outside of class, but hard to stand at 8:15.
